disagreements: The packet's test-10 machine note ('separation certificate 0 -> tube 0 -> target 0 -> the stall guard returns Unresolved') does not reproduce for the specified algorithm. The double cover's curvature radius lower bound comes out 0.399465 against the packet's 0.399506 (0.01% lower, i.e. more conservative; the separation is exactly 0.0 as quoted). This is within the float slack of the outward-rounded interval fixtures (the Decision-7 Leibniz-table fixture uses elementary sin/cos); the tests do not assert the double cover curvature value.
